boards.name: 적 처치 보너스의 맥락
boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a polished yet restrained landscape 1536x1024 GAME DESIGN STORYBOARD for a real Unity mobile running shooter. This is a clearly labelled proposal, not an implemented screenshot. Provided reference is AUTHORITY only for the game gray shark character with two sneaker-wearing feet and tail tip sneaker, rear high-angle camera, friendly low-poly cel shading with thin outlines, wood boardwalk, seafood stalls and cyan sea.
We are fixing CONTEXT. No altar should suddenly spawn when an enemy dies. The proposed new fiction is that the cursed sneakers absorb the usable energy of dropped equipment or supplies, granting temporary run stats. The same small gold SOLE MARK appears on the shoes and underneath selectable items, visually tying cause and effect together. Gold light is supernatural shoe interaction, not an independent new god blessing. Physical drops are recognizable mundane low-poly objects: small gray five-tooth cog / wrench for attack, small muted-teal first-aid pouch with a WHITE HEART PATCH for health. The simple parts correspond to existing prefab categories in the actual repo. Their exact shapes are conceptual, not actual prefab captures. Do NOT make coins: currency remains separate. No gift boxes, no treasure chest, no ritual tables, no pig heads, no temple pillars, no statue, no shrine or magic gate.
Practical asset construction: one or two simple reusable objects per choice, one flat small ground decal with matching shoe-sole icon, two short thin gold trails into sneakers on collection. No star particles, no smoke, no screen-filling glow, no halos above head. Daylight exposure stays constant. All labels concise accurate Korean, use clean bold navy typography with cream header. Scene must remain readable at phone size. Frame sequencing left to right and/or as specified; arrows and minimal short captions make the source, interaction and result obvious. Heading top-right exact "맥락 수정 제안". No other English.

TITLE exact "01 · 적이 놓친 물품을 신발이 흡수"
Layout THREE equal tall panels with bold arrows in gutters. Panel labels "① 적이 놓친 물품", "② 신발이 반응", "③ 흡수 · 임시 강화".
PANEL1: harbor boardwalk, a defeated cartoon worker kneeling harmlessly far ahead at edge, his SMALL plain dark utility pouch has just slipped to ground beside a dropped small wrench and gray cog; show ONE short simple motion arc from pouch to item, not flying magical debris. Gray shark at bottom. Visible source, no giant box. 
PANEL2: same empty location after enemy vanishes, small cog and wrench lying on the planks, a flat narrow gold circle with shoe-sole icon underneath; matching little golden sole symbol lights on shark sneakers. One compact label directly over the object "공격력 +14%". Thin dotted guide from shoe mark to ground mark to explain recognition, not a beam.
PANEL3: shark crosses item spot, cog/wrench fade and two thin gold streams reach the soles, little ground ring fades. At top compact text "공격력 +14%" with small caption "이번 판 동안". Gear does not become permanently attached to shoes. No left/right extra choices in this enemy-drop sequence. Same direction and position progression all panels.
Bottom strip "기존 가방·공구 + 바닥 문양 + 짧은 빛 궤적".

TITLE exact "02 · 길목의 보너스도 출처가 보이게"
Layout TWO equal large panels: left label "발견", right label "선택 · 흡수"; narrow bottom assembly strip.

Nearby small muted-teal first-aid pouch (heart patch) has slipped onto LEFT half of WALKABLE lane, small gray five-tooth cog and wrench on RIGHT half, with clear gap; items sit almost flat on ground, nothing built around them. Their relation to tipped caddy visually evident by proximity. No scattered junk covering the lane. Player shark approaches below. Two compact labels above choices: left "+13" and heart "체력"; right "+14%" and sword "공격력". Each choice sits on one flat subtle GOLD shoe-sole ring decal; glows only because shark is near and its shoes show matching emblem. No big colored platforms.
RIGHT: same setting, shark stepped toward RIGHT choice. Attack parts dissolve as exactly two short warm gold trails reach sneakers. Left choice becomes dim and fades after selection. Tool caddy stays ordinary quiet scenery at edge. All labels consumed disappear; small "공격력 +14%" near shoes then "이번 판 동안". No UI blocking source. Highlight relationship shoe mark -> matching floor mark visually.
Bottom assembly strip has tiny clean isolated images of wooden tool caddy, heart pouch, cog/wrench, flat shoe-sole decal, two simple curves; short text "공구함·구급함·톱니 + 같은 획득 효과".

TITLE exact "03 · 장소가 바뀌어도 같은 규칙"
Layout THREE landscape environment vignettes across top 65%, a wide simple assembly/implementation strip lower 35%. Vignette labels "노량진", "고속도로", "휴게소".
All vignettes depict SAME small gray cog / wrench and teal heart-pouch bonus objects on the WALKABLE ground, with the SAME modest shoe-sole golden decal beneath, same shark with sneakers approaching, realistic mobile-level simple low-poly game look.
Noryangjin: wood pier seafood stalls and a small open wooden tool caddy at edge explain repair supplies. Keep reference look.
Highway: Korean highway SERVICE/MAINTENANCE lane safely separated from fast traffic by low cones, a stationary maintenance vehicle partly visible at side with a small ordinary repair toolbox by its wheel; two dropped supplies are in the player's traversable lane, not unwalkable shoulder. Curved asphalt road, green overhead direction sign in distance without fake readable place names, no giant bridge props or urban fantasy.
Rest stop: service-yard path beside ordinary rest-stop building and supply trolley, plain canvas duffle bag resting at edge, dropped small supplies on path. No shrine. Everyday place.
Bottom assembly strip label "같은 부품 · 같은 효과". Draw simple isolated reusable category models: "가방·공구함" two simple props, "구급함·톱니" small heart pouch and cog, "바닥 문양" flat disk with shoe-sole shape, "흡수 궤적" two fine gold curves leading to sneaker icons. Under it short exact sentence "기존 에셋 + 평면 문양 + 짧은 이동 연출". This strip is conceptual construction and should be visually obvious and uncluttered. No claimed measured performance or fake technical metrics.
